profile_text.body:
Netflix is a publicly traded entertainment company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, listed under the ticker NFLX with CIK 0001065280. On its own site the company describes itself as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a range of genres and languages. It says members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. The same page states the service has over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The material reviewed does not describe any AI products or AI services. Netflix's own description of its business centers on entertainment content and membership plans rather than on artificial intelligence offerings, and no AI products are listed among the products tracked for the company.

Litigation records associated with the company are concentrated in California, where 281 matters are counted. No lawsuits are separately catalogued, and no MCP servers are recorded.
